parameter_descriptions.explanation reliance (\u03b7): Balance between explanation-derived relevance (1) and label-based diagnosticity (0); fixed at 0 in the no-explanation condition.
parameter_descriptions.global relevance reliance (\u03b1): Feature-contribution family only: balance between global learned relevance (1) and instance-local opposition (0).
parameter_descriptions.additive change margin (\u03c1): Extra range-normalized movement added in the predicted direction for each selected feature.
parameter_descriptions.exemplar locality (\u03bb): Weighted-examples family only: higher values concentrate retrieval on more similar remembered examples.
parameter_descriptions.remembered-change reliance (\u03b2): Weighted-examples family: balance between copying remembered change vectors (1) and moving toward remembered endpoints (0).
parameter_descriptions.age treated as actionable (0/1): Whether Age was allowed among candidate edited features in the fitted model.

selection_rule: Minimum five-fold cross-validated selection NLL, then conditional amount MAE, as frozen in cognitive model v0.1.
